summary: My fifth grader came home and said, "We learned about tobacco Dare." Not we learned why tobacco is bad. Realized they grow up in such a tobacco free world they didn't have a cultural relevance to the dangers.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: My fifth grader came home and said, "We learned about tobacco Dare." Not we learned why tobacco is bad. Realized they grow up in such a tobacco free world they didn't have a cultural relevance to the dangers.
